entities.name: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure for a UE to request setup of a default EPS bearer to a PDN. Used to establish first or subsequent default bearers for multiple PDN access.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to request PDN connectivity. Can be included in initial attach or sent stand-alone.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection support
entities.description: Condition indicating whether UE and MME support EMM-REGISTERED state without active PDN connection.

entities.name: Emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition for PDN connectivity requested for emergency services.

entities.name: RLOS access
entities.description: Condition for PDN connectivity for RLOS (Restricted Local Operator Services).

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context establishment
entities.description: Property established when network accepts PDN connectivity request.

entities.name: MME does not check regional/subscription restrictions
entities.description: MME behavior when processing PDN connectivity request for emergency bearer services.

relations.description: UE sends PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message as part of the procedure.
Procedure establishes default EPS bearer context when accepted by network.
Procedure execution depends on EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection support.
When PDN connectivity is for emergency services, MME does not check restrictions.
Emergency bearer services condition restricts when PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST can be sent.
RLOS access condition restricts when PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST can be sent.
